question: The Central Institute of Indian Languages (CIIL) was set up at ______ in 1969.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mysore(Mysuru)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Central Institute of Indian Languages (CIIL) is an Indian research and teaching institute based in Mysuru, part of the Language Bureau of the Ministry of Education. 
 
• It was founded on 17 July 1969.
 
• The institution advises and Assists Central as well as State Governments in the matters of language.
 
• It contributes to the development of all Indian Languages by creating content and corpus.
 
• It protects and Documents Minor, Minority and Tribal Languages and Promotes Linguistic harmony by teaching 20 Indian languages to non-native learner
